description: The implementer's answer. done: the fix is committed on the branch. blocked: you could not do it.

prTitle.description: done: one line, at most 120 characters, written for Shellie's users: it is shown in the app's What's new card and the release notes. What changed for them, no file or function names, no prefix like 'fix:'

prBody.description: done: markdown with ## What changed, ## Why, ## How it was tested, ## Not verified (e.g. Windows only through CI)

risk.description: done: the triage risk, raised to high if the change turned out riskier

reason.description: blocked: why, and what the owner would need to decide
